title: Customer Churn Analysis & Prediction
shortDescription: Machine learning application that predicts whether a customer is likely to churn using demographic, service, contract, and billing data, deployed as an interactive Streamlit app.
problem: Subscription businesses lose revenue when they can't identify at-risk customers early enough to intervene.
solution: Built an end-to-end ML pipeline covering data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, and feature engineering on customer demographics, services, contract, and billing data, then trained and evaluated a classification model and deployed it as a real-time prediction tool.
features: Model training & evaluation (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, ROC-AUC)

title: E-Commerce Sales Dashboard
shortDescription: Interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing e-commerce sales performance, customer behavior, product profitability, and regional trends.
problem: Raw e-commerce transaction data on its own doesn't tell stakeholders where sales, profit, and customer behavior are trending.
solution: Modeled and transformed the sales data with Power Query and DAX, then built dynamic KPIs and visualizations covering sales, profitability, and regional trends to support data-driven decisions.

title: D-Mart Sales Analysis Dashboard
shortDescription: Interactive Tableau dashboard analyzing D-Mart sales performance, profitability, customer trends, and product insights.
problem: Understanding which products and regions drive D-Mart's sales and profit growth requires digging through raw retail data.
solution: Cleaned and visualized D-Mart retail data in Tableau, building visual reports that surface profitability, customer trends, and product-level insights for business decision-making.

title: Drought-Smart Crop Planner
shortDescription: AI-powered crop recommendation application that analyzes soil and weather conditions to suggest suitable crops and provide farming insights.
problem: Farmers in drought-prone regions need to choose crops that match unpredictable soil and weather conditions.
solution: Built a machine learning recommendation engine that combines live weather data (Open-Meteo, NASA POWER) with soil parameters to suggest suitable crops, deployed as an interactive Streamlit app.

title: Blinkit Sales Analysis Dashboard
shortDescription: Interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing sales performance, customer preferences, and product trends using Blinkit's retail dataset.
problem: Stakeholders needed a clear, visual way to monitor Blinkit's sales, orders, and payment trends across categories.
solution: Built an interactive Power BI dashboard with DAX measures and slicers covering sales, orders, profit, quantity, and payment methods, with category, payment, and geographic breakdowns.

title: Smart Toll Booth Collection & Traffic Management System
shortDescription: OOP-based Core Python application that automates toll collection and vehicle management, including FASTag, prepaid passes, and violation handling.
problem: Manual toll booth operations are slow and error-prone, and lack structured records for revenue and violations.
solution: Developed an object-oriented Python system covering vehicle registration, toll calculation, FASTag and prepaid passes, peak-hour charges and discounts, and violation/fine management, with JSON-based storage and role-based authentication.
